title: Hume small business clinics
organiser: Small Business Mentoring Service and Hume City Council
summary: Get an experienced mentor’s feedback on a business idea, including where an AI pilot might help. This is general business mentoring.
eligibility: Small businesses in the Hume Council area. Select Hume in the booking calendar.
terms: The programme page lists 45-minute clinics. Check the booking listing for a price or available time.

title: Applied AI for Business
summary: An eight-week course for implementing a small AI project in your own workplace. VU lists the next round for mid-January 2027.
eligibility: Small and medium businesses and non-technical professionals. No prior AI expertise required.
terms: AUD $330 for one enrolment. Exact start date and enrolment deadline are unpublished.

title: Small Business Bus
summary: Bring a business planning or implementation question to a mobile business adviser. Check the current calendar for a stop near you.
eligibility: Victorian small businesses, including people developing a business idea.
terms: Free mentoring. Availability depends on the calendar.

title: AI Adopt Centres
summary: Get help selecting a use case, testing a tool or preparing an adoption roadmap. Different centres cover different industries.
eligibility: Australian small and medium organisations. Confirm sector and programme eligibility with the centre.
terms: Free support is available to eligible organisations.

title: Victorian eServices supplier register
summary: A path for ICT providers to join Victoria’s supplier register and respond to eligible quotes through Digital Marketplace.
eligibility: ICT providers must complete Supplier Hub registration and the published onboarding requirements.
terms: Contract values are specific to individual procurement opportunities. The register carries no guaranteed work.
sourceMarkers: suppliers may apply to join at any time

title: Cloudflare for Startups
summary: Apply for Cloudflare platform credits to build a product. Review the coverage of the products your project actually needs.
eligibility: Eligible early-stage product companies. Consultancies and service-based agencies are excluded.
terms: Up to 350,000 in platform credits for a year, depending on tier. Credits are not paid compensation.

title: Alice Anderson Fund
summary: A Victorian co-investment fund for early-stage technology companies, including eligible AI startups. Investors submit on behalf of founders.
eligibility: Eligible woman-led Victorian startups with an independent qualifying investor and a current round.
terms: AUD $50,000 to $300,000 in co-investment, with equity and grant components. The organiser accepts applications on a rolling basis. Its displayed committee date has passed.
sourceMarkers: applications are accepted on a rolling basis

title: Enterprise Agentic AI Meetup
organiser: Melbourne AI Developers Group and AICamp
summary: Technical talks and networking on enterprise AI agents. The organiser requires AICamp registration for admission.
eligibility: Developers, founders and people working with AI. Check registration for availability.
terms: Ticket price and registration deadline are unconfirmed.

title: Building, Testing & Deploying AI Agents
location: Royal Society of Victoria, Melbourne CBD
summary: Talks and discussion about agent workflows, testing and deployment on Thursday 10 December.
eligibility: Developers and AI practitioners. Check the event listing for admission and availability.
terms: Ticket price and registration deadline are unconfirmed.

title: OpenWorks
summary: OpenWorks connects small businesses with local AI practitioners. Its published coverage is for US communities.
eligibility: Australian eligibility and local launch timing are unconfirmed.
terms: Australian terms and compensation are unconfirmed.

title: Industry Growth Program
summary: Commercialisation advice and related grant pathways for eligible SMEs. The official programme is paused to new grant applications.
eligibility: Australian incorporated SMEs meeting the programme’s turnover, entity and National Reconstruction Fund priority criteria.
terms: Grant ranges depend on stage and eligibility. Check the official page for the current pause.
